a.xlink:title: Shows the fields of the selected scenario again.
False while no scene is loaded or a run uses it.
The selected scenario or its id or name has changed, or the document is replaced; the argument is hea...
True when a scene is loaded.
Lists the scenarios again and shows the selected one.
Writes the label of each scenario in the list again.
Selects the scenario with the id id.
The scenario of a case that stores none: id "baseline", no incidents and no entrance delays.
A count with the noun that fits it, such as "1 error" or "2 errors".
The scenario id was edited since the scene was saved.
Takes the text of a field that is being edited into the document, as if the user had left the field.
